Language Detection

Detect the programming language of a file from its path/extension or a hint.

Language detection from file extension and content heuristics.

gigacode.language_detect.detect_language(path: str | Path, hint: str | None = None) → str | None[source]

Detect programming language from extension and optional hint.

Parameters:

  • path – File path to inspect.

  • hint – Optional language override. If provided and non-empty, it is normalized and returned directly.

Returns:

Normalized language string or None if not recognised.

gigacode.language_detect.get_tree_sitter_package(language: str) → str | None[source]

Return the likely tree-sitter language package name.

Parameters:

language – Normalized language string.

Returns:

Package name like "tree_sitter_python" or None.
